program.major: Physics with Specialization in Earth Sciences

notes: Listed in the catalog as the focus area 'Physics of the Earth, Oceans, and Atmosphere' within the BS, Physics (PY29) degree, not a separate degree code. This is the closest catalog match to 'Earth Sciences.' Full requirement set = BS Physics core plus five restricted electives from this focus list. Focus list verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units). PHYS 122 also appears in this focus list.

buckets.label: Restricted Electives (Earth/Oceans/Atmosphere focus)
buckets.note: Five restricted electives (20 units), 4+ units each; max two from outside physics (the SIO courses). Catalog verbatim: 'Physics of the Earth, Oceans, and Atmosphere: PHYS 105B, 110B, 116, 122, 140B; SIO 103, 111, 171, 172, 177.'

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units (same as base BS). Total/minimum unit count for the major (109 units = 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division), matching the base BS Physics degree per catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/PHYS-ug.html. No course list needed; satisfied by the sum of units from the other buckets.
